name: Romans
overview: The book of Romans reveals the righteousness of God as a gift received by faith, emphasizing that believers are justified and find peace with God through Jesus Christ. It highlights the reality of sin and its consequence of death, contrasted with the gift of eternal life offered through Christ. Romans also addresses the ongoing struggle with sin in the believer's life while calling for sincere love, abhorrence of evil, and brotherly affection within the Christian community.
